explanation: An sent messenger or representative of Jesus Christ with authority to teach the gospel.
In this context, the right the apostle has not to support himself, which he voluntarily gives up for God's sake.
The reward or recompense a Christian expects in heaven for faithful service and suffering on earth.
A term used regarding discipline; Paul uses it as a metaphor to show that he places himself under discipline despite his freedom, so that the gospel is not hindered.
The good news of God's salvation through Jesus Christ and his death and resurrection.
The work of proclaiming the faith and building up the church as a gift from God to people.
